root_cause.causal_explanation: When Sylas temporarily becomes Shaco to reuse original R executor, shaco clone snapshots temporary u.champ Shaco. The cloned actor owner later restores to Sylas. Public player view therefore shows Sylas real avatar and Shaco decoy avatar, revealing which is genuine. This fails original M15 assertion expecting Sylas clone.
root_cause.desired_rust: Separate immutable real actor identity from temporary executor dispatch identity. Clone visual champ derives from actual Sylas owner, not the original borrowed R donor. Preserve original Shaco R behavior, but projected real and decoy champion should both be Sylas.
